anecdote.title: The Human Signal
anecdote.story: I cared for a non-communicative elderly patient whom others found difficult. By observing non-verbal cues and meticulously logging small behavioral changes, I noticed a pattern related to room lighting. Adjusting it at specific times dramatically improved their comfort and cooperation. It's a lesson I now apply to security, where a single anomalous log entry can signify a much larger issue.
